title: [Dev 3.3.0-dev-d] Semi-tranparent dots mess up the glucose plot
symptom: In AAPS 3.3.0-dev-d with xDrip-G7 as data source and average smoothing ON, some datapoints on the BG plot appear semi-transparent in an alternating way, complicating the graph. The transparent points change places all the time and are not related to missing values.
cause: The semi-transparent dots indicate recalculated (smoothed) values. They appear when there are gaps in the data at the time of receiving a value, causing the value to be recalculated later. This is more common with G7 due to its built-in transmitter and sensor changes, and with xDrip as data source.
fix: No definitive fix was provided. The issue may resolve after a sensor change or after ~48 hours. Some users suggest it is a cosmetic issue that does not affect loop performance. MilosKozak suggested focusing on why there are so many gaps, but the user clarified it's due to smoothing algorithms.
